name: Permanent Residence -- Spouse of a Bahamian

qualifying_event.description: After 5 years of marriage to a Bahamian citizen, with a subsisting and cohabiting relationship, the non-Bahamian spouse may apply for a Certificate of Permanent Residence.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; proof of continuous cohabitation over the 5-year period.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of marriage to a Bahamian citizen with a subsisting, cohabiting relationship.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married and cohabiting for 5 years.

evidence_required.document: Proof of subsisting, cohabiting marriage over 5 years

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Permanent Residence: spousal eligibility category (5 years of marriage with subsisting, cohabiting relationship), $200 processing fee, life-duration Certificate of Permanent Residence giving right to reside and/or work

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. dual_citizenship_allowed left null -- not confirmed on this source (this file models Permanent Residence, not citizenship itself, so dual citizenship rules do not directly apply to this status). citizenship_after_months set to 0 since PR itself is one of the qualifying statuses that can support a subsequent citizenship application via Form I (see bs_citizenship_by_marriage.json), though a separate application and timeline apply. Right to work under PR is 'and/or' per the source (some PR holders may be granted residence only) -- modelled as full work rights as the general case, per the source's own definition ('gives him/her the right to reside and/or work').
